decisions.reason: The ID Vault was freshly launched in 2023 as a feature of the super-app ecosystem and costs little to maintain as part of the identity platform.
The identity-bound wallet only gets a mention and overlaps with the payment framework, so it could be merged into it, but it still fits the super-app story.
The NFC tag authenticator is a niche product but extends the firm's core authentication business at low incremental cost.
It has its own page and is a key payment building block for the super-app platform, which matches the firm's direction.
The multi-service app platform is the flagship and strategic focus of the firm.
Application shielding draws on the firm's long-standing app-security expertise, has its own page, and serves established banking and insurance customers.
